title: Minimum opening.
officialText:
The minimum openable area to the outdoors shall be 5 percent of the floor area of the habitable space being ventilated. Every opening providing required natural ventilation shall be at least 12 square feet (1.1 m2) of glazed area, providing a minimum of 6 square feet (0.56 m2) of openable area.
Exceptions:
1. Where fresh air is furnished in any habitable room or space by mechanical means supplying a minimum of 40 cubic feet per minute (0.02 m3/s), the free openable area of the openings may be reduced to 2½ percent of the floor area but each such opening shall provide not less than 5½ square feet (0.51 m2) of openable area.
2. The minimum free openable area of a mullioned casement window shall be 5½ square feet (0.51 m2), provided that the minimum ratio of floor area to openable area is met.
